purpose: Test whether a thin optional Skill can turn one frozen content-map path into an evidence-grounded topic brief without reselecting the root, inventing business operations, or jumping directly to presentation and drafting.

observations.observation: The father regards eating oysters on the ship as a refined or genteel gesture.
The ragged oyster opener is noticed and then identified as Jules.
After the identification, the family fears recognition and returns on another boat.

failures: The Skill did not explicitly preserve relation names supplied by the map.
The Skill did not explicitly prohibit unsupported author-intent framing.
The Skill did not explicitly track the actual target of a character action.

revision: Preserve supplied edges and add any evidence-supported derived relation separately.
Ask about textual function or effect unless author-intent evidence exists.
Track whom or what characters pursue, avoid, judge, or change toward.

live_probes.accepted_insight: The family tries to perform refinement by eating oysters and, through that same act, encounters poor Jules serving and opening oysters.
failures: It replaced the supplied occurrence edge with a narrative-trigger edge instead of preserving both.
It asked why Maupassant chose oysters despite having no author-intent evidence.
It described the family as changing from wanting oysters to avoiding oysters, although the avoidance target was Jules.

reviewed_topic_brief.preserved_map_path: 海鲜 --下位类别--> 牡蛎 --出现在作品中--> 《我的叔叔于勒》
reviewed_topic_brief.derived_relation: 牡蛎食用场景触发对开牡蛎者的注意与身份确认
reviewed_topic_brief.topic_question: 牡蛎如何在文本中成为擕开一家人体面幻象、显露亲情条件的触发物？
reviewed_topic_brief.central_premise: 一家人想借吃牡蛎靠近体面，却在这个消费场景中认出了正替人开牡蛎的落魄于勒；追求的身份姿态与眼前的穷亲戚发生正面冲突，人物的价值判断因此变得可见。

passed_checks: The original map relations were preserved and the derived narrative relation was separate.
The answer avoided unsupported author-intent claims.
The avoidance target remained Jules rather than oysters.
Source observations, interpretations, and unknown author intent were separated.
No presentation format, sales design, platform plan, experiment quota, or full draft was added.
precision_caveats: The phrase ‘middle-class refinement’ was stronger than the evidence pack; ‘refined or genteel aspiration’ is safer.
The phrase ‘completely dependent on money and status’ was too absolute.
The output used a family-expectation label not included in the supplied three-item evidence pack; it needs another evidence item or omission.
The derived relation target mixed an event with a thematic interpretation and needs held-out schema testing.

retained: A content map path is a retrieval and association route, not yet a topic.
Typed relations prevent category, occurrence, narrative trigger, interpretation, and real-world causality from collapsing into one arrow.
The model should create the premise while external sources verify named works, events, quotations, numbers, and current facts.
A TopicBrief is a useful handoff boundary between mapping and later writing.
A thin optional Skill is sufficient for this first candidate; the experiment does not justify a knowledge base or another mandatory Agent stage.
not_yet_established: Generalization beyond the user-authored seafood development case.
Whether online retrieval outperforms a frozen primary-source evidence pack.
Whether the Skill should be registered in the product.
Whether a stable machine-readable relation schema is needed.
architecture_learning.next_evaluation: Preregister held-out paths covering object-to-history, object-to-real-event, object-to-person, internal conflict, and user-provided private material; compare direct model response, frozen evidence pack, and on-demand search with the same model.
